title: Celery task names must stay pinned for Prometheus liveness alerts
answers: Why do Celery tasks require explicit name arguments?
Where are alert-pinned Celery task names defined?
How to prevent Celery task renames from breaking production alerts?
body:
Tasks monitored by vmalert liveness alerts (such as `FlagsCacheVerificationNotRunning`) must declare their task name constant in `posthog/celery_task_names.py` and pass it to `@shared_task(name=...)`.
Prometheus alerts monitor `increase(posthog_celery_task_success_total{task_name="..."}[window]) == 0`. Relying on Celery's default module-derived naming causes metric labels to change when moving or refactoring task functions, firing false alerts. Specifying explicit names in `posthog/celery_task_names.py` also pre-creates Prometheus counter series at worker startup via `posthog/celery.py:worker_process_init`.
applies: Applies to periodic or critical Celery tasks that have corresponding Prometheus/vmalert liveness alerts.
says: Production monitoring fired false alerts that background verification jobs stopped running
Background task liveness monitors trigger alarms after routine worker updates
Prevent false alarm notifications when background maintenance tasks run normally
Monitoring dashboard shows zero activity for active feature flag cache workers
